datasets.name: Main
datasets.sql:
select  f.name,f.restpr,sum(h.rest*o.ostat),f.interestpr,sum(intr.interest*o.ostat)  from 
cm_portfolio p,smart.operkurs o,
cm_history h, smart.filial_t f,
(select i.creditid, sum( round(i.interest,2)) interest  from 

CM_INTERESTS i
where

i.hdate between  CM_COEFFICIENT.get_year((select tek_dat from smart.sysdat))
                           and  ( :dat)
                          -- and i.creditid in ( select id from cm_portfolio )
                           
 group by i.creditid) intr                      

where
p.id=h.creditid and p.currency=o.val_kod and o.dat=:dat and
p.branchid=f.id and
h.hdate = ( :dat) and
p.id=intr.creditid

group by f.name,f.restpr,f.interestpr
order by f.name
